problem.statement: Bounded Review and Learn research signals must produce long-term explainable manipulation-resistant progression across legitimate study patterns.
problem.primary_invariant: Comparable learning results must not gain systematic advantage from more technical events, larger backlog, more sessions or farmable configuration.

terminology_definitions.CORE_ECONOMY: G4 research economy combining bounded Review and Learn contributions; not a production economy.
terminology_definitions.REVIEW_DOMAIN: Research domain sourced from Review XP with an unresolved two-candidate uncertainty axis.
terminology_definitions.LEARN_DOMAIN: Research domain sourced from the recommended Learn XP candidate while preserving its confirmatory limitation.
terminology_definitions.DOMAIN_SIGNAL: Typed research evidence emitted by one domain; not a production event or price.
terminology_definitions.DOMAIN_CONTRIBUTION: Bounded explainable amount derived from an eligible domain signal after future normalization.
terminology_definitions.REVIEW_UNCERTAINTY_AXIS: Required parallel treatment of P-STEP-ZERO and P-TAPER-ZERO-30D without a selected winner.
terminology_definitions.NORMALIZATION: Future typed transformation from heterogeneous domain signals into a common comparative interface.
terminology_definitions.CONVERSION_POLICY: Future versioned rule relating normalized Review and Learn contributions; no ratio is selected in G4.1.
terminology_definitions.PRODUCTIVE_DAY: Research classification built from bounded eligible signals; it does not require study every calendar day.
terminology_definitions.DAILY_PRODUCTIVE_SIGNAL: Decomposable day-level evidence after domain eligibility and bounded aggregation.
terminology_definitions.RAW_VOLUME: Unbounded technical event or object count insufficient by itself to establish productivity.
terminology_definitions.BOUNDED_CONTRIBUTION: Contribution constrained against event multiplication, backlog, configuration and calendar manipulation.
terminology_definitions.DIMINISHING_RETURNS: Future optional compression concept; no function or parameters are selected.
terminology_definitions.LEVEL: Presentation of cumulative bounded progression; not mastery, certification, intelligence or human worth.
terminology_definitions.LEVEL_CURVE: Future versioned mapping from cumulative bounded progression to presentation levels.
terminology_definitions.STREAK: Presentation of productive-day continuity; not XP or moral evaluation.
terminology_definitions.STREAK_GROWTH: Increase of streak state after a future qualifying productive day.
terminology_definitions.STREAK_PRESERVATION: Retention of streak state without growth, including the planned-rest boundary.
terminology_definitions.PLANNED_REST: Neutral rest with no XP, no streak growth, no streak break and no debt.
terminology_definitions.UNPLANNED_ABSENCE: Non-productive interval creating no negative XP debt; exact streak handling is deferred.
terminology_definitions.MOMENTUM: Bounded explainable non-spendable indicator of study rhythm; never a direct XP multiplier.
terminology_definitions.RECOVERY: Future return-to-rhythm behavior without backlog multiplier, debt or exploitable return bonus.
terminology_definitions.BACKLOG: Accumulated due work; its size alone is not a reward source or multiplier.
terminology_definitions.SESSION_SPLITTING: Partitioning the same work into more sessions; it must not increase contribution.
terminology_definitions.CALENDAR_BOUNDARY: Civil date/time boundary distinct from Anki day and session grouping.
terminology_definitions.ANKI_DAY: Typed Anki scheduler-day aggregation axis; not automatically a calendar day.
terminology_definitions.PERSONA: Synthetic workload class used for fairness analysis; never a real user profile.
terminology_definitions.FAIRNESS: Absence of systematic exploit or devaluation of legitimate workflows, not equal XP for unequal useful work.
terminology_definitions.FARMING: Synthetic strategy increasing progression without comparable bounded productive signal.
terminology_definitions.EXPLAINABILITY: Ability to decompose progression into typed domain/day contributions, reasons and limitations.

BEGINNER_HEAVY.purpose: Early study with high Learn share and small Review base.
BEGINNER_HEAVY.fairness_risk: Learn-heavy normalization may dominate or be undervalued.
BEGINNER_HEAVY.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Large new-material counts do not prove confirmed learning.

MATURE_DECK.purpose: Mature collection dominated by Review work.
MATURE_DECK.fairness_risk: Review-heavy users may be penalized by a Learn-centric economy.
MATURE_DECK.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Large due volume can reflect legitimate maintenance or backlog.

BALANCED.fairness_risk: Cross-domain conversion may double-count or privilege one signal class.
BALANCED.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Similar raw totals can hide different bounded domain contributions.

BACKLOG_RETURNER.purpose: Legitimate return after accumulated due work.
BACKLOG_RETURNER.fairness_risk: Backlog size can become a multiplier or recovery penalty.
BACKLOG_RETURNER.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Backlog volume does not distinguish farming from ordinary return.

LOW_VOLUME_CONSISTENT.fairness_risk: Productive-day thresholds may erase meaningful low-volume work.
LOW_VOLUME_CONSISTENT.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Low raw volume can still contain valid bounded signals.

INTENSIVE_LEARNER.fairness_risk: Caps may erase valid work while flooding may inflate it.
INTENSIVE_LEARNER.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Raw new-card volume cannot distinguish confirmation from exposure.

ALTERNATING_INTENSIVE_LIGHT.purpose: Alternating heavy and light legitimate days.
ALTERNATING_INTENSIVE_LIGHT.fairness_risk: Streak, Momentum or daily thresholds may punish natural variance.
ALTERNATING_INTENSIVE_LIGHT.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Averages and totals hide day-shape fairness.

PLANNED_REST_SCHEDULE.fairness_risk: Daily-streak pressure can punish healthy planned rest.
PLANNED_REST_SCHEDULE.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Zero activity on planned rest is not failed productivity.

IRREGULAR_LEGITIMATE.purpose: Non-uniform legitimate study constrained by real life.
IRREGULAR_LEGITIMATE.fairness_risk: Calendar and recovery rules may create permanent disadvantage.
IRREGULAR_LEGITIMATE.raw_volume_not_sufficient: Irregular raw volume does not imply manipulation.

DOMAIN_IMBALANCE.protected_principle: Normalize domains without silently selecting a Review winner.

RAW_VOLUME_FARMING.protected_principle: Use bounded eligible signals rather than raw count.

BACKLOG_FARMING.protected_principle: Backlog size is not a multiplier.

NEW_MATERIAL_FLOODING.protected_principle: Only confirmed bounded Learn signals are candidate inputs.

CALENDAR_BOUNDARY_FARMING.protected_principle: Separate Anki day, calendar day and session.

CONFIGURATION_FARMING.protected_principle: Configuration is context, not a price.

ANSWER_BEHAVIOR_FARMING.protected_principle: Buttons are evidence, not direct prices; honest Again is protected.

STREAK_PRESSURE.protected_principle: Growth, preservation, XP and Momentum remain separate.

PLANNED_REST_EXPLOIT.protected_principle: Planned rest is neutral and not a reward.

RECOVERY_BONUS_LOOP.protected_principle: Return creates neither bonus loop nor debt.

MOMENTUM_SNOWBALL.protected_principle: Momentum is bounded and never a recursive multiplier.

UNCERTAINTY_COLLAPSE.protected_principle: Both Review candidates remain explicit inputs.

EXPLANATION_OPACITY.protected_principle: Progression remains decomposable by domain and day.

INV-G3-CREATE-XP-EXCLUDED.semantics: Create XP and G3 are excluded from the initial core economy.

INV-REVIEW-UNCERTAINTY-PRESERVED.semantics: Both Review candidates remain parallel inputs without a winner.

INV-LEARN-LIMITATION-PRESERVED.semantics: The Learn candidate remains CONFIRMATORY_INCONCLUSIVE and not production-ready.

INV-SCHEDULER-UNCHANGED.semantics: G4 does not change Anki scheduler behavior.

INV-DUE-DATES-UNCHANGED.semantics: G4 does not write due dates or intervals.

INV-NO-DIRECT-BUTTON-PRICING.semantics: Again/Hard/Good/Easy have no direct core-economy price.

INV-HONEST-AGAIN-NOT-PUNISHED.semantics: Honest Again is not punished solely for reporting failure.

INV-NO-RESPONSE-TIME-REWARD.semantics: Response speed has no positive reward path.

INV-NO-TIME-SPENT-REWARD.semantics: Time spent in the application is not rewardable by itself.

INV-NO-BACKLOG-SIZE-GAIN.semantics: Backlog size alone cannot increase contribution.

INV-NO-NEW-MATERIAL-FLOOD-GAIN.semantics: New-card, note, import or exposure volume cannot substitute for confirmed Learn signals.

INV-NO-CONFIGURATION-GAIN.semantics: Presets, limits, steps or scheduler configuration alone cannot increase contribution.

INV-XP-NONNEGATIVE.semantics: Cumulative research progression never becomes negative.

INV-LEVEL-MONOTONIC.semantics: Level presentation is monotonic within one versioned economy.

INV-PLANNED-REST-NEUTRAL.semantics: Planned rest gives no XP, no streak growth, no streak break and no debt.

INV-NO-ABSENCE-XP-DEBT.semantics: Absence creates no negative XP debt.

INV-RECOVERY-NO-BONUS-LOOP.semantics: Recovery cannot create a leave-return reward loop or backlog multiplier.

INV-STREAK-NO-XP-MULTIPLIER.semantics: Streak is never a direct XP multiplier.

INV-MOMENTUM-NO-RECURSIVE-MULTIPLIER.semantics: Momentum neither directly multiplies XP nor recursively mints itself.

INV-DETERMINISTIC-REPLAY.semantics: The same frozen inputs produce identical outputs.

INV-DECOMPOSABLE-EVIDENCE.semantics: Every decision and contribution has typed source and reason evidence.

INV-EXPLAINABLE-CONTRIBUTIONS.semantics: Progression can be decomposed by domain and day without opaque scoring.

INV-RESEARCH-ONLY.semantics: G4 remains isolated research and does not enter runtime, package or release.

INV-NO-REAL-USER-DATA.semantics: Only synthetic identifiers, personas and traces are used.

INV-NO-PRODUCTION-APPROVAL.semantics: No G4 outcome or artifact approves production.

requirements.statement: Preserve P-STEP-ZERO and P-TAPER-ZERO-30D as an explicit Review uncertainty axis.
Do not select a Review winner without a prospectively defined cross-domain criterion.
Preserve C-CONFIRMATION-ONLY-D1-NOTE-SIBLING and its CONFIRMATORY_INCONCLUSIVE limitation.
Define typed domain input records and decomposable contribution records.
Define a common normalization interface without selecting production XP or a conversion ratio.
Formalize the daily aggregation boundary from bounded eligible domain signals.
Separate Anki day, calendar day and session as typed axes.
Define fail-closed behavior for missing, ambiguous or conflicting domain inputs.
Define synthetic persona descriptors without exact execution traces.
Define deterministic fixture requirements for threats, invariants and fairness comparisons.
Define how G4.3 may introduce candidate families without selecting formulas in G4.2.
Do not select conversion ratio, productive-day threshold, level curve, streak, Momentum or recovery formulas.
Do not run an economy simulation or create a screening matrix.
Do not change production runtime, dashboard, API, scheduler, FSRS, database, package, workflow or release surfaces.
